results.title: Gompertz Linear Units: Leveraging Asymmetry for Enhanced Learning Dynamics
results.reason: The paper proposes GoLU, a new self-gated activation function that can be dropped into the FFN of a language model, and it is evaluated on language modeling among other tasks.
results.evidence: we introduce the Gompertz Linear Unit (GoLU), a novel self-gated activation function

results.title: ReLU$^2$ Wins: Discovering Efficient Activation Functions for Sparse LLMs
results.reason: The paper compares FFN activation functions in LLMs and argues for ReLU^2 as the most efficient choice for sparse computation, which is an architectural component choice.
results.evidence: highlighting its potential as an efficient activation function for sparse LLMs

results.title: ProteinNet: a standardized data set for machine learning of protein structure
results.reason: This paper presents a standardized dataset for protein structure machine learning and proposes no neural architecture or component.
results.evidence: We have created the ProteinNet series of data sets to provide a standardized mechanism for training and assessing data-driven models

results.title: Induced subgraphs of hypercubes and a proof of the Sensitivity Conjecture
results.reason: This is a pure combinatorics and theoretical computer science proof about hypercube subgraphs and boolean function sensitivity, and it describes no neural architecture.
results.evidence: we prove that the sensitivity and degree of a boolean function are polynomially related
